samples.summary: OOXML relationship-target resolution is duplicated between slides and docs, and this fix only lands in the slides copy. `packages/slides/src/import/pptx/rels.ts:45` now normalizes `.`/`..` and package-root (`/...`) targets, while the docx importer resolves targets by bare concatenation (`const path = `${baseDir}${rel.target}``, docx-importer.ts:698, plus `word/${rel.target}` at :193), so a DOCX with `Target="/word/media/image1.png"` or `../media/...` still resolves to a non-existent zip entry. rels.ts:15 explicitly documents the split as deliberate ("kept separate so the slides package doesn't depend on docs internals"), so this is pre-existing duplication rather than something the diff introduced, but the two answers to the same OOXML question now diverge further. A shared resolver in `@wafflebase/core` (per the repo's reuse expectation, docs/design/shared-core-extraction.md) would be the fitting home.
searchedFor: grep for a shared rels util in @wafflebase/core
